title: STS2 AI Agent
changeNote: v0.13.0: fixes to what the mod tells an AI agent about the game, found by checking every name it looked up against the game actually installed. Relic counters, card keywords and enchantments, and monster move lists had been silently empty; a combat resumed from a save could hide end turn and play card for good (thanks @XenoAmess); and several buttons were being pressed in a way the game's buttons ignore. The health check now also reports whether every game internal the mod relies on still exists, so a future game patch shows up as 'degraded' with the missing pieces named instead of as silently wrong data. Nothing changes for your runs: no cards, no numbers, no saves are touched.
